tool.name: nf-core integronfinder
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [ "$is_compressed_fasta" == "true" ]; then gzip -c -d $fasta > $fasta_name fi
integron_finder \\ $args \\ --cpu $task.cpus \\ $fasta_name
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": integronfinder: \$(integron_finder --version 2>&1 | head -n1 | sed 's/^integron_finder version //' | cut -d ' ' -f1) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Detect integrons in DNA sequences
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: integronfinder Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/integronfinder ]]>
